facts.text: Bon Secours Memorial College of Nursing is owned and operated by Bon Secours Memorial Regional Medical Center and launched its four-year BSN degree program in 2010.

sources.title: Our History - Bon Secours Memorial College of Nursing
sources.quote: In response to the growing evidence showing a positive correlation between a nurse's education level and patient outcomes, the school launched a four-year Bachelor of Science in nursing degree in 2010 and became the College we know today.

sources.title: Our History - Bon Secours Memorial College of Nursing
sources.quote: Bon Secours Memorial College of Nursing is a department owned, operated and controlled by Bon Secours Memorial Regional Medical Center, LLC.
